name: Omeprazole
description: A substituted benzimidazole that irreversibly inhibits the gastric H+/K+ ATPase, approved for gastro-oesophageal reflux disease, ulcer disease and hypersecretory states. Prolonged use is associated with magnesium, B12 and iron malabsorption.

systems.note: Gastric acid suppression; the labelled indications.
Hypomagnesaemia with prolonged use and acute interstitial nephritis are labelled.
Reduced absorption of vitamin B12 and iron with prolonged acid suppression.
Increased fracture risk with prolonged high-dose use is labelled.
Hepatically metabolised by CYP2C19; hepatic injury is documented.

monitors.why: Labelled hypomagnesaemia with prolonged use; specifically called out in labelling.
Acid suppression reduces B12 liberation from dietary protein.
Acid suppression reduces non-haem iron absorption.
